Mateo Garcia  
📍 Tel Aviv, Israel | 📞 +972-52-345-6789 | 📧 mateo.garcia@sentinelcyber.com | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/mateogarcia  

Professional Experience  
Over the past decade, I’ve focused on building scalable machine learning systems that enhance cybersecurity operations. At Sentinel Cybersecurity Solutions, I led the design of MLOps pipelines using MLflow, which reduced model deployment latency by 40% and enabled real-time anomaly detection across 15+ enterprise clients. My work involved optimizing large language models for threat intelligence, where I fine-tuned transformers to improve false positive rates by 25% in high-stakes environments. Previously, at Vulcan Security, I developed natural language processing pipelines that processed 200,000+ threat reports monthly, integrating REST APIs to streamline data ingestion from external intelligence sources. This system became a core component of the company’s threat analysis platform. Early in my career, as a Data Scientist at CyberShield Analytics, I built predictive models for malware detection using scikit-learn and TensorFlow, achieving 92% accuracy in identifying zero-day threats. These models were later integrated into the company’s SIEM tools, enhancing incident response times by 30%.  

Technical Skills  
I specialize in deploying machine learning at scale within cybersecurity infrastructure. My work with Hugging Face Transformers includes leading the adaptation of BERT-based models for threat classification, which reduced manual analysis time by 50% for the security operations team. I’ve also optimized LLMs for real-time query processing, enabling sub-second response times for threat intelligence lookups. In MLOps, I architected pipelines that integrate PyTorch and TensorFlow models into Kubernetes clusters, ensuring seamless model versioning and rollback capabilities. My REST API designs have facilitated cross-team collaboration, allowing data science and engineering teams to share models and datasets efficiently. I’ve deployed models using Docker containers, which improved deployment consistency across development, staging, and production environments. AWS services like S3 and EC2 are integral to my workflow, supporting scalable training and inference workloads. For NLP, I’ve built end-to-end pipelines that process unstructured text data, from preprocessing to embedding generation, and have integrated these systems into production via Kubernetes. My scikit-learn expertise includes designing ensemble models that balance precision and recall in high-noise datasets.  

Education  
Master of Science in Computer Science, University of California, Berkeley (2015). Thesis focused on adversarial machine learning in network security, with a focus on robustness against evasion attacks.  

Projects  
- **Threat Intelligence Automation Platform**: Designed a system that automates the ingestion, analysis, and prioritization of threat data. Leveraged Hugging Face Transformers for intent recognition in unstructured reports, reducing analyst workload by 60%.  
- **LLM-Driven Anomaly Detection**: Developed a model that combines PyTorch-based neural networks with prompt engineering techniques to detect anomalous network behavior, achieving 94% F1 score in production.  
- **MLOps Pipeline for Cybersecurity**: Built a scalable pipeline using MLflow and Kubernetes, enabling automated model retraining and monitoring, which cut deployment time by 50% and improved model reliability.  

Certifications  
AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty (2022), Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) (2021).  

Languages  
English (fluent), Hebrew (professional working proficiency).  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized for contributions to Sentinel’s real-time threat detection system, which earned a 2023 Cybersecurity Innovation Award. Nominated for Best Use of AI in Cybersecurity at the Israeli Tech Summit 2022.
